alignment_simulation.alignment_center_default: center of full C12–C1 / H01–H15 staple grid, including middle column gap
alignment_simulation.alignment_center_frame: unshifted image-site coordinates; C6 H01 is (0,0)
alignment_simulation.alignment_distribution: independent zero-mean Gaussian dx, dy, angle; shared rigid transform within each origami
alignment_simulation.alignment_error_frame: origami-aligned axes, before decoded shift and display rotation
alignment_simulation.edge_handling: Gaussian tails outside the field are cropped without renormalization
alignment_simulation.finite_count_scope: alignment uncertainty only; fractional site intensities, no occupancy or photon noise
alignment_simulation.normalization: mean per design; normalization balances unequal quadrant sampling and fixes total design weight; shared exposure, no image-dependent scaling

gaussian_reconstruction.alignment_center_default: center of full C12–C1 / H01–H15 staple grid, including middle column gap
gaussian_reconstruction.alignment_center_frame: unshifted image-site coordinates; C6 H01 is (0,0)
gaussian_reconstruction.alignment_distribution: independent zero-mean Gaussian dx, dy, angle; shared rigid transform within each origami
gaussian_reconstruction.alignment_error_frame: origami-aligned axes, before decoded shift and display rotation
gaussian_reconstruction.edge_handling: Gaussian tails outside the field are cropped without renormalization
gaussian_reconstruction.finite_count_scope: alignment uncertainty only; fractional site intensities, no occupancy or photon noise
gaussian_reconstruction.normalization: mean per design; normalization balances unequal quadrant sampling and fixes total design weight; shared exposure, no image-dependent scaling

geometry.array_coordinate_frame: origami-local; rotate clockwise by origami_rotation_degrees_clockwise for upright image display
geometry.bit_meaning: Joint 7-bit codebook identifies color, quadrant and local XY shift.
geometry.bit_order: bit 1 is the most significant bit; bit 7 is the least significant bit
geometry.code_formula: channel_index * x_states * y_states + y_shift * x_states + x_shift
geometry.pixel_mapping: Concatenate quadrant sampling grids; use pixel_centers/edges for nonuniform physical spacing.
geometry.quadrant_offset_convention: field offset plus half the difference between this quadrant's pitch and the first quadrant's pitch

optimization.method: bounded expected-error optimization with within-origami covariance and droplet refinement
optimization.objective: mean image squared error + (1 + variability penalty) * finite-count alignment variance + regularization * mean squared departure from direct assignments

png_coordinate_frame: upright image; JSON RGB arrays remain origami-local
quantized_rgb_role: per-site intensity reference; predicted appearance is gaussian_reconstruction
